variants.headline: Still in view: cyclone hits the colony
variants.sub: The colony has been struck by a cyclone.
variants.body:
A cyclone has hit the colony. Coverage continues after {months_running} months; this is a continuing story rather than a fresh announcement.

A political movement should be judged by its conception of common responsibility when nature is difficult. We stand with {target} against an easy verdict; a principled politics should also be a fair one.
